name: T053 (v0.7 part 2): a top-level `keys.<name>` declaration carrying a member outside SPEC.md §9's closed per-key vocabulary (demand, provide, cascade, final, delegate) is refused at its own position — closing the one closed vocabulary in the language that had no `unknown-...` refusal behind it (Constitution Principle VI). `seal:` is the concrete case that motivated it: the spelling moved into `demand` earlier in v0.7 and was, until now, silently accepted here.
